# Grid

Arranges children in a grid, with a fixed number of columns or filled automatically by a minimum column width.
Use it for card walls, grids of entry points and two-column forms.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Card grids, grids of entry points on a home page, two- or three-column forms

## Import

```ts
import { Grid } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Without a number of columns, the grid fills the row automatically by minimum column width (`md`, 240 px, by
default).

```tsx
import { Box, Grid, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Grid>
      {['Files', 'Messages', 'Members', 'Documents', 'Settings'].map((t) => (
        <Box key={t} surface="surface" border radius="lg" padding={4}>
          <Text weight="medium">{t}</Text>
        </Box>
      ))}
    </Grid>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Two fixed columns

Use a fixed number of columns for two-column forms and details.

```tsx
import { Grid, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function TwoColumns() {
  return (
    <Grid columns={2} gap={4}>
      <Text tone="secondary">Username</Text>
      <Text mono>alex.morgan</Text>
      <Text tone="secondary">Team</Text>
      <Text>Design</Text>
    </Grid>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | Fixed number of columns; when omitted, columns are filled automatically by `minColumn` (responsive to the width). | — | No |
| `minColumn` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Minimum column width when filling automatically: `sm` 160 px, `md` 240 px, `lg` 320 px. | `'md'` | No |
| `gap` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Space between rows and columns, as a spacing step. | `3` | No |
| `padding` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted. | — | No |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'section' \| 'header' \| 'footer' \| 'nav' \| 'aside' \| 'main' \| 'ul' \| 'ol' \| 'li'` | HTML element to render. | `'div'` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
